author: dstoenner
notes_extra: Match AR15 and a 223 midrange Remington 700, both 1:8. Cases are LC, Norma, or Lapua, so the case is not stored as one brand. Groups between .375 and .5. He uses them; the thread is 55 gr FB Berger Target.
